Vendored source including bundled dependencies. Built for A64 by nixe-cpu-jit.

Nixe adaptations:
- backend/exception_handler{.h,_posix.cpp}: expose cold fault resolution and
  allow nixe to own POSIX signal capture (DYNARMIC_EXTERNAL_FAULT_HANDLER).
- backend/x64/a64_emit_x64.cpp: check halt/budget at linked and indirect/return
  transitions so scheduler preemption and memory transitions remain bounded.
- frontend/A64/translate/impl/sys_dc.cpp: end blocks after cache operations;
  nixe applies ownership transitions after dropping its execution lease.
- ir/opt/a64_get_set_elimination_pass.cpp, ir/opt/passes.h and
  backend/x64/a64_interface.cpp: retain setters visible at memory-abort exits
  while still forwarding register values and eliminating redundant accesses.

The Rust/C ABI integration is in crates/cpu-jit. The generic native fault
capture implementation is shared with the interpreter in cpu-direct-memory.
